"""RED contract tests for ephemeral laboratory ingestion using synthetic data only."""
    
    from dataclasses import fields
    from importlib import import_module
    
    IngestionInputPort = import_module(
        "clinical_ingestion.application.ports.inbound"
    ).IngestionInputPort
    extraction = import_module("clinical_ingestion.domain.extraction")
    EXTRACTION_STATES = extraction.EXTRACTION_STATES
    ExtractionResult = extraction.ExtractionResult
    FieldResolution = extraction.FieldResolution
    DecisionPolicy = import_module("clinical_ingestion.domain.policy").DecisionPolicy
    
    
    EXPECTED_EXTRACTION_STATES = {
        "verified",
        "not_present",
        "missing",
        "ambiguous",
        "malformed",
        "truncated",
    }
    
    
    def test_extraction_states_are_exhaustive_and_field_resolution_is_explicit() -> None:
        """Every available-inventory field is represented by exactly one known state."""
        assert set(EXTRACTION_STATES) == EXPECTED_EXTRACTION_STATES
    
        result = ExtractionResult(
            fields=(
                FieldResolution(code="lab_marker_alpha", state="verified"),
                FieldResolution(code="lab_marker_beta", state="not_present"),
                FieldResolution(code="lab_marker_gamma", state="missing"),
                FieldResolution(code="lab_marker_delta", state="ambiguous"),
                FieldResolution(code="lab_marker_epsilon", state="malformed"),
                FieldResolution(code="lab_marker_zeta", state="truncated"),
            ),
            provenance=None,
        )
    
        assert {resolution.code for resolution in result.fields} == {
            "lab_marker_alpha",
            "lab_marker_beta",
            "lab_marker_gamma",
            "lab_marker_delta",
            "lab_marker_epsilon",
            "lab_marker_zeta",
        }
        assert {resolution.state for resolution in result.fields} == EXPECTED_EXTRACTION_STATES
    
    
    def test_policy_rejects_required_fields_that_cannot_be_verified() -> None:
        for blocking_state in ("missing", "ambiguous", "malformed", "truncated"):
            decision = DecisionPolicy().decide(
                ExtractionResult(
                    fields=(FieldResolution(code="lab_marker_alpha", state=blocking_state),),
                    provenance=None,
                ),
                required_field_codes={"lab_marker_alpha"},
                privacy_controls_complete=True,
                residual_pii_phi_found=False,
            )
    
            assert decision.approved is False
            assert "REQUIRED_FIELD_NOT_VERIFIABLE" in decision.codes
    
    
    def test_policy_rejects_residual_pii_phi_and_incomplete_privacy_controls() -> None:
        decision = DecisionPolicy().decide(
            ExtractionResult(
                fields=(FieldResolution(code="lab_marker_alpha", state="verified"),),
                provenance=None,
            ),
            required_field_codes={"lab_marker_alpha"},
            privacy_controls_complete=False,
            residual_pii_phi_found=True,
        )
    
        assert decision.approved is False
        assert {"RESIDUAL_PII_PHI", "PRIVACY_CONTROLS_INCOMPLETE"} <= set(decision.codes)
    
    
    def test_ingestion_port_returns_only_a_safe_technical_decision() -> None:
        result = IngestionInputPort().ingest(b"synthetic-laboratory-input")
    
        assert result.approved in {True, False}
        assert set(result.codes)
        assert {field.name for field in fields(result)} == {"approved", "codes", "counts"}

"""RED contract tests for the in-memory laboratory adapter with synthetic inputs."""
    
    from importlib import import_module
    
    LaboratoryFamilyAdapter = import_module(
        "clinical_ingestion.adapters.outbound.laboratory"
    ).LaboratoryFamilyAdapter
    
    
    def test_laboratory_adapter_classifies_synthetic_laboratory_content() -> None:
        adapter = LaboratoryFamilyAdapter()
    
        result = adapter.extract(b"LABORATORY_REPORT marker_alpha")
    
        assert result.is_laboratory is True
    
    
    def test_laboratory_adapter_rejects_a_non_laboratory_document_safely() -> None:
        adapter = LaboratoryFamilyAdapter()
    
        result = adapter.extract(b"UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT synthetic")
    
        assert result.is_laboratory is False
        assert result.rejection_code == "UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_FAMILY"
    
    
    def test_ephemeral_provenance_contains_only_technical_location_metadata() -> None:
        adapter = LaboratoryFamilyAdapter()
    
        result = adapter.extract(b"LABORATORY_REPORT marker_alpha")
    
        assert result.provenance is not None
        assert set(result.provenance) == {"page_number", "block_index"}
        assert all(isinstance(value, int) for value in result.provenance.values())
        assert "LABORATORY_REPORT" not in repr(result.provenance)
